semantic_review.summary: No semantic conflict found. Every non-test file that patches of two PRs touch was read, hunk by hunk with its enclosing function, at candidate-54's commits; each pair edits different functions or different keys of one table, except packed_bf16.py, where #998 round 1's guard is the fix for its interaction with #997. No rebase was needed: all 30 patches apply cleanly in series order (receipts/stack.log, section 1).
semantic_review.what_is_new_here: Each file a round-2 patch touches is byte for byte the file of that patch's own candidate stack on the round-2 base (candidate-50 without #1009, tree 14c5a2dc): candidate-51 with #963 and #1001 round 1 (tree 35cd2a0e, the trees those reworks measured), candidate-52 (tree 1116740c, its lock) and candidate-53 with #960, #971 and #998 round 1 and without #984 (tree 8b643f4b). Candidates 51, 52 and 53 touch no common file, and no round-2 patch touches #1009 round 1's six files (receipts/stack.log, section 3). So candidate-54 combines, for the first time: #1009 round 1 with round 2 (disjoint files), and candidate-53's three reworks with each other and without #984 (each rework was verified beside the others' original patches and #984). #960 round 1 and #998 round 1 meet only in model_runner.py (reviewed below); #971 round 1 shares no file with either.

files.review: #965 round 1: add_requests, prepare_inputs and sample_tokens (decode-step H2D and ATen work). #980 round 1: load_model, the sampler's seed argument. #998 round 1: load_model, confirm_streamed_weights also takes the drafter model (getattr(self.speculator, 'model', None)); a different statement of load_model from #980's. #960 round 1: execute_model's attention-metadata branch, which on a non-dummy FULL step with captured metadata, no active KV connector (kv_connector is NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR) and a speculator that does not read the target's metadata calls model_state.stage_full_cudagraph_attn instead of prepare_attn. Different functions, or different statements of one. No conflict.

#980 round 1: sample_draft calls the estimator's predict_from_stats. #960 round 1: the class attribute uses_target_attn_metadata = False (which lets the runner's FULL fast path run with this drafter), and the padding-row mask rewritten in propose only when the live row count changes (_padding_live, reset in __init__, capture and reset_attn). Different methods. No conflict.

#1013 adds a ubatch_idx parameter to prepare_attn. #960 round 1 adds a class attribute and two methods before prepare_attn (stage_full_cudagraph_attn, prepare_cudagraph_replay); its fast path calls stage_full_cudagraph_attn, never prepare_attn with ubatch_idx. No conflict.

#997: the screening buffers in create_weights and _ensure_screen_weights in process_weights_after_loading. #998 round 1: process_weights_after_loading compacts the packed values unless the layer holds the carve-out screening table (_carveout_screen_wq). The two interact by design: #998's first version compacted the carve-out buffer that also holds #997's table, the release-test segmentation fault of candidate-53, and round 1's guard is the fix (104 passed on the two failing files, candidate-53/receipts/rework/pr-998-r1/result.json). A resolved interaction, not a conflict.

#966: the L2 evict_first policy of grouped_fp8_fp4_gemm's TMA weight loads. #1030: moe_swiglu_cast and its kernel (BF16 rounding before MXFP8). Different kernels. No conflict; candidate-52 measured #1030 on the base with #966.

#1016 round 1: DECODE_FP8_CONFIGS 64-row Q-B tiles of (12288, 1280) and (8192, 1280). #991 round 1: the MXFP4 quantize epilogue of the MXFP8 decode GEMMs. #963 round 1: packed BF16 GEMM row-bound loads and PDL chaining on wide grids (_packed_bf16_gemm, packed_bf16_gemm_two). #987: 128-row DECODE_FP8_CONFIGS entries and WIDE_DECODE 128 for the WO-B shapes (5120, 3072|2048|1024). #1016 and #987 edit different keys of one table; the others edit different kernels. No conflict; candidate-51 and #963 round 1 measured these on the base with #1016 and #991.
